title: Week 5 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “separation of powers”?
options: Allocation of legislative, executive, and judicial authority to different branches.
The ease with which an asset can be used for payment or converted to spendable funds without major loss.
Human time, effort, skill, and knowledge used in production.
An election used to select party nominees or narrow the field of candidates.
questions.explanation: Separation of powers means allocation of legislative, executive, and judicial authority to different branches.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “checks and balances”?

A tradition holding that moral principles can be discovered through reason and apply beyond enacted rules.

A legal guarantee of equal status, participation, or protection.

A reasonable basis, grounded in facts, to believe a crime occurred or evidence will be found.
A formal change to the Constitution adopted through Article V procedures.
